big_ticket.reason: Revenue comes from ongoing contract work billed over time, not single large purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Engineers, scientists, developers and mission experts deliver the consulting and technical work customers pay for.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are US federal government agencies.
